Smt.Jayasree K.P. Hamza vs Thariyode Grama Panchayat on 9 April, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21857980/ 1 Govt. Pleader Sri. S. Dileep S. This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Been Finally Heard On 09.04.2019, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: WP(C).No.30679 of 2018 :2 : Judgment
texts.facts: ~~~~~~~~~ Petitioner challenges Ext.P6 order of the 2 nd respondent whereby he has been directed to stop unauthorised fish vending in the building owned by one Raghavan Nair. 2. The petitioner submits that he has been engaged in fish vending for long years. After the Panchayat started a public market, the Panchayat is insisting that no fish vending will be permitted within 3 KM radius of the public market. According to the petitioner, the stipulation is against the statutory rules and he cannot be forced to stop his business. Respondents 1 and 2 have filed a counter affidavit in which it has been so stated.
